Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding repair and reuse of electronic products by registered collectors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repair and reuse of electronic products byregistered collectors; and adding a new section to chapter 70.95N RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.95N RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Only entities registered as collectors with the department may actas collectors. All covered electronic products received by aregistered collector must be submitted to a plan, except fullyfunctional covered electronic products. Products that are received bythe registered collector in working order may be sold or donated aswhole products by the collector for reuse. Computer and computerrelated products that require minor repairs may be refurbished withinthe state to a fully functional covered electronic product by theregistered collector for reuse according to its original purpose.Registered collectors may use parts gleaned from collected electronicproducts for making minor repairs within the state as long as theremaining parts, components, and units are submitted to a plan.Collectors may not include covered electronic products that are gleanedfor reuse in the weight totals for compensation by the plan. p. 1 HB 1522Collectors must report to the department the number of coveredelectronic products sold or donated by the collector, and if more thanten units are sold or donated to a single person, then the collectormust provide the department with the name and address of that personand the quantity sold to that person.
